history.content: got passed over for the senior role today. third time. they gave it to someone i trained
That hurts to read, especially the third time and then seeing it go to someone you trained.
its not really the role. its what it means. like maybe i was never as good as i thought
I had that wrong, let me step back. What word feels closer than hurt?
idk a word. its more like. my hands go cold when i open my laptop now. keep thinking theyre all gonna figure out im a fraud
My guess is this sits more in that shaky, exposed place than in hurt alone, and your hands going cold gives it a very clear body. What does it do in you when you open the laptop, besides the cold?
chest gets tight. i reread old emails looking for proof i screwed up. cant stop. like im building a case against myself
That sounds like a tightening, self-checking loop, and it carries that exposed, “I’ve got to prove myself wrong” feeling. We can stay with just that, or keep going a little if you want.
keep going i guess. its been there longer than today honestly. my whole life ive been the one who tries hard not the one whos actually talented. today just proved it
That “today just proved it” sounds like it gave the old story fresh evidence, not just a bad day. Does it feel more like shame about who you are, or disappointment in what this meant?
neither really. its more scared. like if im not the talented one then who even am i. and what happens when everyone sees it. that part keeps me up
That feels like the fear has opened into a question about belonging and being seen, not just the role itself. What happens when everyone sees it, in the version that keeps you up?
they let me go. quietly. and everyone nods like they always knew. and i go back to being nobody. thats the loop. over and over at 3am

That loop has a very stark kind of fear in it, with being let go, everyone nodding, and then dropping back into “nobody.” We can stay here with the loop, or if you want, we can look at what it’s asking for underneath.
yeah. underneath. i think i just want to know im worth something even if im not the best. dont know if i believe that yet

There’s a longing there for worth that doesn’t depend on being the best, and the not believing it yet matters too. We can stay with that, or if you want, we can look at what makes it so hard to trust.
not tonight. but this helped. didnt have words for it til now. thanks. gonna try to sleep
I’m glad it has words now, and we can leave it there for tonight. I hope sleep comes gently.
